# OmniFlow Studio — WebMCP AI Documentation

> OmniFlow Studio is a collaborative visual systems architecture studio where AI agents and human engineers co-create, simulate, and synthesize production cloud infrastructure in real-time via the W3C WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) standard.

## AI Agent Integration

This browser application exposes 28 structured tools directly on `window.document.modelContext`. When loaded in an agent-enabled browser (such as Google Chrome 149+ with `#enable-webmcp-testing` or ChatGPT Sites), agents can discover and invoke these tools to interact with the user's active canvas.

### Core Tool Categories
- **Canvas Inspection & FinOps**: `inspect_canvas_state`, `estimate_cloud_costs`, `benchmark_ai_models`, `simulate_global_geo_distribution`
- **Graph Topology Construction**: `create_node`, `update_node`, `delete_node`, `connect_nodes`, `disconnect_nodes`, `batch_build_architecture`, `apply_layout_preset`, `load_architecture_template`
- **Traffic Physics & Chaos Lab**: `simulate_traffic`, `stop_simulation`, `inject_ddos_attack`, `kill_random_node`, `simulate_gpu_oom`, `auto_heal_cluster`, `toggle_autonomous_autopilot`
- **Security & Synthesis**: `run_security_audit`, `optimize_architecture`, `generate_infrastructure_code`, `generate_architecture_manifesto`, `export_canvas_image`
- **Declarative Form Tools**: `<form toolname="quick_add_component">`, `<form toolname="trigger_quick_optimization">`

### Discovery Manifest
- WebMCP Manifest: `/.well-known/webmcp.json`
- Source Code & Architecture: `https://github.com/Anurag-tech22/omniflow-studio-webmcp`
